intro: Slimline brings effortless style and intelligent storage to modern bedrooms. With an integrated mirror, concealed locker, and customisable shelves, it gives a wardrobe designed for the way you live.

features.title: Timeless Grey Oak finish for refined spaces
features.text: Slimline Dual’s balanced Grey Oak tone complements a wide range of interior styles, from minimalist bedrooms to more expressive décor themes, making Slimline a versatile addition to contemporary homes. Also, the wardrobe’s pre-coated surface ensures it retains its elegance through regular use.

features.title: Concealed locker for discreet, secure storage
features.text: A hidden locker keeps your valuables safely tucked away from sight without disrupting the almirah's clean silhouette. Privacy and security are built in, not bolted on.

features.title: Adjustable drawer partitions and bangle holder for precise organisation
features.text: The drawer of this almirah features flexible partitions and a dedicated bangle holder, allowing you to customise how your jewellery and accessories are arranged. Everything stays sorted, visible, and within easy reach.

features.title: Multiple adjustable shelves for storage tailored to you
features.text: Reconfigurable shelves let you adapt the interior layout to suit your wardrobe as it evolves. Clothes, accessories, and essentials all find their place exactly where you need them.

features.title: Deep drawer for tall and oversized items
features.text: Generously proportioned to accommodate tall bottles, bags, and bulkier belongings, the deep drawer makes storing awkward items completely effortless. Slimline Dual is designed for the things that never quite fit anywhere else.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
